title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: Jonas Noury
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Median household income") +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_001",
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  year = 2020,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```

```{r}
edu_summary <- edu_state |>
  filter(variable != "B15003_001") |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    pct_bachelors_or_higher = sum(estimate) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_bachelors_or_higher))

ggplot(
  edu_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(NAME, pct_bachelors_or_higher), y = pct_bachelors_or_higher)
) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "State",
    y = "Percentage of adults",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-year estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
